_comment: role.c genl_player_setup() (2299-2304), restore.c restore_menu() and wintty.c erase_tty_screen() (2047-2052): the first segment leaves a saved game. In the second, the name typed at start-up is generic, answer `a` leaves "Incompatible role!" pending, and role_init()'s plnamesuffix() shows the saved-games menu again; tty_clear_nhwindow(BASE_WINDOW) erases the screen and retires the line. Ctrl-P recalls it after the new name is typed.
